scope: Repeated Manager/harness failures for wave-plan reviewer-B stages wave-plan-reviewer-b-round-01 and wave-plan-reviewer-b-round-01-retry.
questions_answered: What concrete failure pattern is visible in .saivage/stages/wave-plan-reviewer-b-round-01*/summary.json and plan history?
Is there any hidden reviewer-B artifact or report outside architecture-audit/wave-plan-reviews/round-01-reviewer-b.md that can be accepted?
What stage objective/acceptance criteria changes are most likely to produce the required reviewer-B artifact while preserving the mandatory separate reviewer stage?
Should the plan remove or retain wave-plan-decision until reviewer-B sign-off exists?

findings.title: Executive summary
findings.answer: The two reviewer-B wave-plan stages failed before producing the required artifact; both stage summaries record reviewer worker cancellations and explicit absence of architecture-audit/wave-plan-reviews/round-01-reviewer-b.md. No acceptable hidden reviewer-B wave-plan artifact exists in the audited safe paths. The plan must retain wave-plan-decision as a pending gate, but it must not execute or pass until a separate reviewer-B stage produces a real sign-off or corrections artifact.

findings.title: Q1: Concrete failure pattern in summaries and plan history
findings.answer: The pattern is missing-artifact failure after reviewer runtime cancellation, surfaced through harness/schema failures in plan history. wave-plan-reviewer-b-round-01 summary says the reviewer worker was cancelled on both attempts before producing the review artifact, with attempt 1 failing with 'LLM error: Agent cancelled' and the retry failing immediately with 'Cancelled' (.saivage/stages/wave-plan-reviewer-b-round-01/summary.json:4,10,26). It records files_created as empty for both reviewer tasks and missing_required containing architecture-audit/wave-plan-reviews/round-01-reviewer-b.md (.saivage/stages/wave-plan-reviewer-b-round-01/summary.json:11,27,39-46). Acceptance criteria passed only stage separation/no reviewer-A work, while artifact existence and verdict criteria failed (.saivage/stages/wave-plan-reviewer-b-round-01/summary.json:48-68). The retry stage repeats the same pattern: first dispatch ran but failed with 'LLM error: Agent cancelled', second failed immediately with 'Cancelled', and no artifact was produced (.saivage/stages/wave-plan-reviewer-b-round-01-retry/summary.json:4,10,17,46-48,65-82). Plan history adds the harness/schema wrapper facts: original reviewer-B failed with 'issues file fields were null' and retry failed with 'escalation.created_at required', while both history entries say no artifact/sign-off/corrections existed (.saivage/plan-history.json:208-223,226-241). Root cause visible from these artifacts is not a wave-plan content rejection; it is the reviewer/manager/harness execution path failing before the mandatory artifact is written.

findings.title: Q2: Hidden artifact/report search result
findings.answer: No acceptable hidden reviewer-B wave-plan artifact or report was found. architecture-audit/wave-plan-reviews contains only round-01-reviewer-a.md, not round-01-reviewer-b.md (tmp/inspector-workspace/wave-plan-reviewer-b-evidence.txt, section 'wave-plan review dir'). Both wave-plan reviewer-B stage directories contain only summary.json and tasks.json, with no reports/ or reviews/ subdirectory (tmp/inspector-workspace/wave-plan-reviewer-b-evidence.txt, section 'b stage dirs'). A safe reviewer-B filename search found baseline reviewer-B artifacts and baseline stage reports, plus the two failed wave-plan reviewer-B stage metadata files, but no wave-plan reviewer-B report other than tasks/summary metadata (tmp/inspector-workspace/wave-plan-reviewer-b-evidence.txt, section 'reviewer-b named safe files'). Baseline reviewer-B artifacts cannot be accepted for Phase 2 wave-plan sign-off because they review the Phase 1 baseline, not architecture-audit/wave-plan.md.

findings.title: Q3: Stage objective/acceptance changes most likely to produce reviewer-B artifact
findings.answer: The most likely successful change is to schedule a fresh separate reviewer-B stage whose objective prioritizes writing the markdown artifact early and forbids returning schema-problematic structured issues. The stage should remain separate from reviewer-A, assigned to the reviewer role, and require the first task to create architecture-audit/wave-plan-reviews/round-01-reviewer-b.md with a minimal header, inputs reviewed, criteria list, and final verdict; then fill wave-by-wave assessment. Acceptance should be filesystem-first: pass only if that exact file exists and contains either 'SIGN OFF — no further corrections required' or 'REQUIRED CORRECTIONS' with numbered actionable items. To reduce cancellation risk, narrow the requested output format and explicitly instruct that any blockers/content issues must be written into the markdown artifact rather than returned as null issue fields or escalation; if the reviewer cannot complete exhaustive prose, it should still write REQUIRED CORRECTIONS explaining incomplete review rather than leaving no artifact. Do not add a manager-authored substitution criterion: unlike the reviewer-A retry, the active project objective says both reviewers must be served by the reviewer agent role in separate plan stages, so acceptance should preserve reviewer-B provenance instead of allowing manager synthesis.

findings.title: Q4: wave-plan-decision disposition
findings.answer: Retain wave-plan-decision as the pending gate, but do not run it as a decision that can pass until reviewer-B sign-off exists. Removing the stage would obscure the required Phase 2 gate; advancing it now would violate the dual-reviewer protocol because only reviewer-A has an accepted wave-plan sign-off. The current pending stage should either remain blocked or be preceded by a new reviewer-B-only retry stage. Its acceptance criteria should explicitly fail closed when architecture-audit/wave-plan-reviews/round-01-reviewer-b.md is absent or lacks a valid SIGN OFF/REQUIRED CORRECTIONS verdict.

evidence: .saivage/stages/wave-plan-reviewer-b-round-01/summary.json:4 states both reviewer attempts were cancelled before producing architecture-audit/wave-plan-reviews/round-01-reviewer-b.md.
.saivage/stages/wave-plan-reviewer-b-round-01/summary.json:10 and :26 record 'LLM error: Agent cancelled' then immediate 'Cancelled'.
.saivage/stages/wave-plan-reviewer-b-round-01-retry/summary.json:4 records a 57-minute cancelled run, only reviewer-A present, and an immediate second cancellation.
.saivage/stages/wave-plan-reviewer-b-round-01-retry/summary.json:65-82 records failed artifact existence and verdict criteria.
.saivage/plan-history.json:208-223 records original reviewer-B stage failed at schema boundary because issues file fields were null and no artifact existed.
.saivage/plan-history.json:226-241 records retry failed at schema boundary because escalation.created_at was required and no artifact existed.

tmp/inspector-workspace/wave-plan-reviewer-b-evidence.txt shows architecture-audit/wave-plan-reviews contains only round-01-reviewer-a.md and the reviewer-B wave-plan stage directories contain only tasks.json and summary.json.

recommendations.action: Insert/schedule a fresh separate stage, e.g. wave-plan-reviewer-b-round-01-retry-02, assigned only to the reviewer role, before wave-plan-decision.
acceptance_criteria: File header identifies Reviewer-B and the fresh stage id
File states inputs reviewed including architecture-audit/wave-plan.md and signed-off baseline decision
File contains exactly one final verdict: 'SIGN OFF — no further corrections required' or 'REQUIRED CORRECTIONS' with numbered actionable corrections

recommendations.action: Revise reviewer-B stage instructions to require artifact-first behavior: write a minimal markdown skeleton and final verdict to architecture-audit/wave-plan-reviews/round-01-reviewer-b.md before returning any structured task issues; document all plan issues in markdown rather than returning null issue/file fields or escalating for content concerns.
acceptance_criteria: Stage objective says missing artifact is unacceptable unless filesystem write fails
Structured issues, if any, use non-null safe file strings or are omitted in favor of markdown REQUIRED CORRECTIONS
Cancellation/incomplete review is represented as REQUIRED CORRECTIONS in the artifact if the reviewer can write files

recommendations.action: Keep wave-plan-decision pending and make it fail closed unless both architecture-audit/wave-plan-reviews/round-01-reviewer-a.md and round-01-reviewer-b.md exist and contain compatible SIGN OFF verdicts, or else report the exact correction/reviewer rerun stages needed.
acceptance_criteria: wave-plan-decision is not removed from the plan
wave-plan-decision does not create architecture-audit/wave-plan-decision.md without reviewer-B artifact
If reviewer-B is missing or requires corrections, decision summary names the next required correction/reviewer stage
